items.source: Add a return statement if the given condition is true.
items.translation: 如果给定条件为true，则添加一个返回语句。

items.source: Build the code block representing the return statement.
items.translation: 构建代表返回语句的代码块。

items.source: Add a fallback return statement if no previous return statement was added.
items.translation: 如果没有添加之前的返回语句，请添加一个备用返回语句。

items.source: Builder for constructing return statements based on the target return type. The resulting CodeBlock must be added as a CodeBlock.Builder.addStatement(CodeBlock).
items.translation: 用于根据目标返回类型构建返回语句的构造器。生成的 CodeBlock 必须作为 CodeBlock.Builder.addStatement(CodeBlock) 添加。
